name: Austin Disaster Relief Network
description:
Churches of Greater Austin Bringing Hope Into Crisis

We are a trained network of churches offering physical, emotional, and spiritual support to disaster survivors to meet short and long-term needs.

By serving our communities in times of crisis, we offer the transforming hope of Jesus Christ.

name: ARK of Highland Lakes
description:
Bringing Hope to the Highland Lakes

Since 2018, the Ark of Highland Lakes has united churches and community members to provide hope, healing, and transformation for neighbors experiencing crisis in our region.

name: BRACE
description: Be Ready Alliance Coordinating for Emergencies (BRACE) is Northwest Florida’s leading disaster preparedness, response, and recovery organization. Serving Escambia and Santa Rosa Counties, BRACE strengthens community resilience by coordinating more than 500 partner organizations, training volunteers through Citizen Corps, CERT, and Fire Corps programs, and managing both county Long-Term Recovery Groups. As the fiscal agent and ESF-15 (Volunteers & Donations) lead for Escambia County and Santa Rosa County Emergency Management, BRACE mobilizes resources and volunteers before, during, and after disasters to meet the needs of impacted families. The organization also leads public education efforts such as the StormWise Disaster Preparedness Workshop, Disaster Services Expo, Faith Leader Emergency Summit, Disaster Services RoundTable, and Storms & Stars Soiree, which connect residents, businesses, and community leaders with the tools and training to prepare, mitigate, and recover from disasters. Through collaboration, compassion, and innovation, BRACE helps Northwest Florida build safer, stronger, and more resilient communities.

name: Love Acadiana
description:
Love Acadiana is a Christian nonprofit based in Lafayette Parish (Acadiana), Louisiana, that exists to unite churches, businesses, nonprofits, and volunteers to meet practical needs while sharing the love of Christ. Rather than replacing local ministries, they serve as a collaborative hub that connects people and resources to address some of the region's greatest challenges.

Their ministry focuses on several key areas:

  • Foster Care & Family Support – Recruiting and supporting foster families, providing resources, and caring for vulnerable children.
  • Disaster Response & Recovery – Mobilizing volunteers, coordinating donations, and partnering with churches and community organizations following hurricanes, floods, and other disasters.
  • Homeless Outreach – Serving individuals experiencing homelessness through practical assistance and relationships.
  • Prison Ministry – Supporting incarcerated individuals and helping families impacted by incarceration.
  • Single Moms & Widows – Providing encouragement, resources, and community support.
  • Education & Community Initiatives – Partnering with schools and local organizations to strengthen families and neighborhoods.

What makes Love Acadiana especially effective is its emphasis on collaboration. They bring together churches, ministries, businesses, and civic leaders to identify needs, coordinate responses, and maximize Kingdom impact across the Acadiana region rather than working in isolation. This collaborative model has made them a trusted partner during disasters and throughout year-round community outreach.

name: For Columbus
description: Because we love our city and want it to flourish, we develop strategic infrastructure, like a trellis for a vine. We gather networks of leaders across the city and unify the Church to pray for and practically address the city’s greatest needs. We’re turning Jesus’ prayer for unity in John 17 into a tangible movement of congregations, nonprofits, and workplaces for the flourishing of Columbus.

name: Together Nashville
description: Together Nashville is a transformational city network dedicated to the holistic flourishing of Nashville through the unity of the Church. Rooted in Jesus' prayer recounted in John 17, Together Nashville seeks to serve the Church of Nashville through building relational and missional unity in the body of Christ in our city.

name: Good Works Community
description:
We know from experience that leading a faith-based nonprofit can be both extremely rewarding and uniquely challenging.


Our community is designed to help you and your Christian nonprofit operate with excellence and maximize your impact.

name: Firefighters For Christ Intl
description: Firefighters for Christ goes where the need is greatest—whether it’s responding to disaster zones, training responders in underserved regions, or bringing the hope of Christ across borders. Explore the different ways you can serve.

name: Houston Impact Network
description:
Mobilizing Houston for Collective Impact.

Through our three programs: Church Coalitions, Flourish Forums and Serve HTX our goal is to unite individuals & organizations to meet the critical needs in their communities.

name: Serve 6.8
description: SERVE 6.8 exists to mobilize, resource and connect the local Church to meet needs in its local community. We partner with 65 churches and thousands of volunteers to meet needs in Jesus’ name. Collectively, we meet the needs of families through Resource Centers, Disaster Relief, Project Assistance, and Adopt-A-Family (Thanksgiving meals and Christmas gifts).

name: ATX Outreach
description:
ATX Outreach Connections are intentionally planned and developed by local Church outreach leaders for Outreach Leaders. There is no denominational boundary. We are bible based and believe Jesus Christ is the Hope of the world and our city!


The purpose is to develop an ongoing relationship between outreach-minded Church leaders so that each of us, together, reduce the lostness of greater Austin.

 

We are looking forward to connecting with you!

name: AustinServes
description:
Connecting people, churches, nonprofits, and community organizations with opportunities to make a difference across Greater Austin. Whether you're looking to volunteer, find support, or partner with others who care about their community, Austin Serves helps you discover programs, events, and resources focused on mental health, disaster relief, homelessness, food insecurity, family support, and more.

Our mission is simple: to make it easier for people to find ways to serve, connect, and strengthen the communities they call home.

Together, we can create greater impact by connecting needs with resources and people with opportunities to serve.
